title: Associated sheaf scalar action on all sections
statement: For a commutative ring R, an R-module M, a in R, and an endomorphism f acting as a times the identity on M, tilde(f) acts as a times the identity on sections over every open of Spec R. The associated-sheaf functor is the one used by [lem-pc-affine-perfect-module-model].

proof.text: Apply extensionality to section functions. The map acts pointwise by Localizations.comapFun. The linear equivalence modulesSpecToSheafIso identifies the coordinate-ring scalar with pointwise scalar multiplication. Represent each localized value by m/s; comapFun_mk gives f(m)/s, and the input equality and smul_mk give a times m/s.
